observations: Photo 0: A large TV screen displaying a colorful image of vintage cars in front of a domed building. On-screen overlay shows 'QLED 85Q70C' and 'SAMSUNG' logo.
Photo 1: Same TV showing a beach volleyball scene. On-screen overlay again shows 'QLED 85Q70C' and 'SAMSUNG' logo.
Photo 2: Same TV showing a red vintage car on a city street. On-screen overlay again shows 'QLED 85Q70C' and 'SAMSUNG' logo.
All photos show the same TV with consistent on-screen branding and model label.
The TV is mounted on a wall with blue and white diagonal stripes.
No physical branding or model labels visible on the TV bezel or back in any photo.
The on-screen model label appears to be part of the TV's display settings or demo mode, not a physical sticker.

claims.claim: apple airplay||google assistant||alexa inbuilt||ambient mode||smart things||bibxy||digital...
claims.evidence: No interface or settings screen is shown to verify these smart features. The on-screen display only shows model info, not functionality.

risks.risk: The TV may not be the advertised model (85Q70C) and could be a different or lower-end model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the physical model label on the back or bottom bezel of the TV.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic 85-inch QLED TV, not the specific Q70C model.

risks.risk: The smart features (AirPlay, Alexa, Google Assistant, etc.) may not be functional or may be disabled.
risks.proof: A screenshot or video showing the TV's smart menu with these features enabled and working.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-smart or basic smart TV, not a full-featured smart TV.

risks.risk: The TV may be damaged or have screen issues (e.g., dead pixels, burn-in, backlight bleed) not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the TV displaying solid colors (black, white, red, green, blue) and moving content to check for defects.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having potential screen defects, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the physical model label on the back or bottom bezel of the TV.
Video or screenshot showing the TV's smart menu with AirPlay, Alexa, Google Assistant, and other features enabled.
Video showing the TV displaying solid colors and moving content to check for screen defects.
response.reason: The model is identified from on-screen text, but physical proof is needed to confirm it. Smart features cannot be verified from current photos. Screen condition and potential defects are hidden risks that must be checked before pricing.
